title: 第3章 混沌神钟恭送系统第4章 炼化灵宝先天大巫
slug: 洪荒开局吞噬十一祖巫
content_zh:
就在帝江感觉系统那边“网络延迟”
高得离谱，仿佛正在和什么不可名状之物进行“拔河比赛”
时——
叮咚！
您的洪荒限定版混沌钟已到账！
请查收！
记得五星好评哦亲（系统提示音带着一丝不易察觉的虚弱）！
一道混沌之气缭绕的古钟虚影，强行撕裂了盘古神殿内部的空间，带着一种不情不愿的震颤，“哐当”
一声，砸在了帝江的巨蛋旁边。
钟声悠扬，带着镇压鸿蒙的无上威严，却又隐隐透着一股刚被“绑架”
过来的委屈。
“卧槽！
真搞来了！”
帝江所在的的蛋壳激动得流光溢彩，恨不得立刻破壳而出抱着钟亲两口。
混沌钟啊！
从此以后，请叫他帝·太一（终极版）·江！
然而，帝江高兴了不到三秒。
一股无法形容、冰冷、浩瀚、至高无上的意志，如同无形的亿万钧重压，骤然降临盘古神殿！
这股意志不带任何感情，仿佛只是纯粹规则的集合体，却比任何杀气都令人窒息。
它直接锁定了帝江的巨蛋，以及那颗刚刚“快递”

过来的混沌钟。
“被，被盯上了！”
帝江的蛋壳瞬间凉了半截，意识仿佛被冻僵。
那是洪荒天道！
真正的洪荒管理员！
帝江能感觉到，天道的目光先是扫过混沌钟，带着一丝确认，然后如同最冰冷的手术刀，精准地刺向他意识深处与系统连接的羁绊。
警告！
遭遇高维规则反制！
系统核心遭受不可逆…滋滋…宿主保重…根据《跨位面打工系统权益保障条例》…我…我一定会回…回来…………
系统的电子音断断续续，如同被干扰的电台，最后在一阵刺耳的杂音中，戛然而止！
那股与帝江相连的，虽然不靠谱但确实存在的联系，彻底断了！
系统，被天道当场格式化了！
临走还留下了灰太狼式的经典台词，但帝江心里拔凉拔凉的，感觉这次怕是永别了。
天道解决了系统这个病毒程序和外来插件，冰冷的目光立刻毫无阻碍地落在了帝江这颗罪魁祸首的蛋上。
帝江毛骨悚然，感觉自己就像砧板上的一条鱼，不，一颗待孵化的蛋！
完了完了，刚穿越就要被天道当BUG清理了吗？吞噬弟妹的报应来得这么快？
就在他以为自己下一秒就要蛋碎道消之际，他体内那源自盘古的浓郁血脉之力，以及那开天辟地时融入祖巫本源、平日里不显山不露水，但此刻感受到天道压迫而自主激发出的三成开天功德，轰然勃发！
嗡——！
content_en:
Just feeling "network delay" on the Dijiang system
Ridiculously high, as if we were engaging in a tug-of-war with something indescribable.
When——
Ding dong!
Your prehistoric limited edition Chaos Clock has arrived!
Please check!
Remember to give me the five-star review, dear (the system prompt sound has a subtle hint of weakness)!
A shadow of an ancient bell surrounded by the energy of chaos forcibly tore apart the space inside Pangu Temple, with a reluctant tremor, "clang"
With a sound, it hit the dome next to Dijiang.
The bell sounded melodiously, carrying the supreme majesty of suppressing Hongmeng, but also faintly revealed the feeling of someone who had just been "kidnapped"
Come over and feel the grievance.
“Fuck!
It’s really done! "
The eggshell where Di Jiang was sitting was so excited that he wished he could break out of the shell immediately and hug Zhong and kiss him.
Chaos clock!
From now on, please call him Emperor Taiyi (Ultimate Edition) Jiang!
However, Di Jiang was happy for less than three seconds.
An indescribable, cold, vast, and supreme will, like the weight of invisible billions, suddenly descended on Pangu Temple!
This will has no emotion, as if it is just a collection of pure rules, but it is more suffocating than any murderous intention.
It directly locked onto Dijiang’s dome and the one that had just “delivered”
Come over to the Chaos Clock.
"Being, being targeted!"
Di Jiang's eggshell instantly became half cold, and his consciousness seemed to be frozen.
That is the ancient way of heaven!
The real prehistoric administrator!
Di Jiang could feel that Tiandao's gaze first swept over the Chaos Clock with a hint of confirmation, and then, like the coldest scalpel, it accurately pierced the connection between the system and the depths of his consciousness.
warn!
Encountered countermeasures by high-dimensional rules!
The core of the system suffers irreversible damage...Zizi...Host, take care...According to the "Regulations on the Protection of Rights and Interests of Cross-dimensional Working System"...I...I will definitely come back...come back...
The electronic sound of the system was intermittent, like an interfered radio station, and finally stopped abruptly in a burst of harsh noise!
The unreliable but real connection with Dijiang was completely severed!
The system was formatted on the spot by Tiandao!
Before leaving, he also left behind a classic line in the style of Big Wolf, but Di Jiang's heart was filled with chills, feeling that this time he was afraid of saying goodbye forever.
Tiandao solved the virus program and foreign plug-ins in the system, and his cold eyes immediately fell on Di Jiang, the culprit's egg, without any hindrance.
Di Jiang's hair stood on end, he felt like a fish on the chopping board, no, an egg waiting to be hatched!
It's over, it's over, are you going to be cleared by Tiandao as a bug just after time travel? The retribution of devouring the younger siblings comes so quickly?
Just when he thought he was going to be destroyed in the next second, the rich power of blood originating from Pangu in his body, as well as the 30% of the merits of opening the heaven that were integrated into the origin of the ancestral witches at the beginning of the world and were usually invisible, but at this moment felt the pressure of heaven and inspired themselves, suddenly burst out!
Buzz—!
